title: Chapter 8 - Where to change things
introduction: A practical lookup for maintaining the site. Find the task in the contents, use the UI when it already supplies the control, and use the named source anchors when changing implementation. All paths start at `C:/Dropbox/Resume Website/`.

Each code anchor was checked against the local source while generating this edition. Line numbers are snapshot hints; search for the named function or literal when lines move. A function nested inside another function is a source location, not necessarily an API you can call externally.

These are source-verified references, not a claim that every browser workflow has passed acceptance. UI names describe current source; Constructor availability can depend on page, active face and review context. Export private content before testing changes.

Companion chapters 1-7 explain saving, shared settings, faces, content, media, assets and troubleshooting. This lookup adds specific implementation anchors; it is not an exhaustive catalog of every internal function.

tasks.check: Change the control, inspect its actual feature, reload, then check a clean/default context without clearing unrelated content. Test any old saved value that needs migration.

tasks.title: Change how a note sticks to a 3D surface

maintenance: Editable task records are in `docs/user-guide/08-task-to-script-reference.json`. Add a task under its page/group with a UI route, exact file/literal anchors, change boundaries and a meaningful verification check. Prefer named declarations/configuration keys over a line number alone.

Rebuild from the repository root: `python tools/build-user-guide.py docs/user-guide/08-task-to-script-reference.json`. Use the installed/bundled Python if the Windows Store alias intercepts python. ReportLab and pypdf are required; Poppler renders the result for visual review.

The builder rejects missing files and missing literal anchors. That catches some stale references; it cannot prove a function is still the active owner or that the UI route still exists. Recheck imports/call sites and the browser workflow when a feature changes. Snapshot line numbers are recalculated each build.

Cross-PDF navigation is in each footer; Chapter 9 supplies the derived alphabetical script/function index with links back to these task pages. Keep all PDFs together. Use `python tools/build-user-guide.py --all` after changing tasks so the index and destination pages are rebuilt together. Browser acceptance, more screenshots and broader field/asset coverage remain. Continue adding high-value tasks instead of cataloging every private helper.

Separate deferred work: deliberate folder migration/obsolete-file review, controller architecture and animation standardization, plus mobile/device acceptance. Coordinate file reservations before edits and request the agreed quiet window before moves. No publication or desk continuation is authorized by this documentation pass.
